_doc: Stop hook config: when files under a listed folder changed (since the last passing commit, or uncommitted), every check for it runs before the agent may stop. Commands run in that folder; non-zero exit = fail; exit 3 = skipped (reported, never a pass).

prototypes/body-hop: [ -d node_modules/playwright ] || { echo 'browser replay (tools/bot.js) SKIPPED: run npm install in prototypes/body-hop'; exit 3; }; node tools/bot.js
